name: Can I remove black spots or mold from walls myself?

mainEntity.name: Can I remove black spots or mold from walls myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can attempt to clean very small, superficial black spots if you are certain it's not extensive mold growth and the area is dry. However, for anything more than a small patch (e.g., less than 10 square feet) or if you suspect hidden mold behind walls, a professional is highly recommended. DIY methods can inadvertently spread mold spores, miss the underlying moisture problem, or expose you to health risks. Professionals have the right equipment and expertise for safe and effective removal.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can remove very small, superficial black spots yourself if it's not extensive mold. For larger areas or suspected hidden mold, professional help is advised to prevent spread and ensure safety.
